name: wrongcmd
description: Plays a sound when an invalid command is typed in the terminal.

wrongcmd.errorKeywords.description: Terminal phrases that trigger the sound. Add custom ones for your specific shell.

wrongcmd.soundChoice.description: Select the built-in sound to play, or choose 'Custom' to use your own file.

wrongcmd.customSoundPath.description: Absolute path to a custom .wav file on your computer (Used only if 'Custom' is selected above).
